completionEvidence.quote: (주)우리금융지주가 설립됨에 따라 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE) 에 상장되었던 우리은행 ADR이 상장 폐지되고, (주)우리금융지주의 ADR이 기존 우리은행 ADR과 1:1 의 교환비율로 2019년 1월 11일 NYSE에상장등록될 예정이며, 원주기준의 ADR 실제교환은 (주)우리금융지주 주식의 국내 상장 예정일인 2019년 2월 13일에 이루어질 예정입니다.
completionEvidence.note: Independent later filing (NYSE ADR delisting notice, receipt 2019-01-11, filed AFTER the three unavailable 2018 body corrections 20180920000544/20181108000137/20181121000025) states in the past tense that 우리금융지주 WAS established, and restates the SAME trading-termination date (2019-01-11) already filed in the primary decision under the field name '3. 매매거래종료일' -- corroboration from a source independent of the missing corrections, filed after all three. This establishes the share transfer actually occurred and independently corroborates the effective date, so effectiveDate resolves via ALTERNATIVE_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE despite the missing corrections. It does NOT independently restate the primary bank's own common-share consideration/ratio (the 1:1 figure quoted here is the ADR program's own conversion ratio, never re-cited as successorSharesPerOldShare), so terminal consideration stays blocked by the unavailable corrections.
